overall_goal: Add mushroom stock and sour cream to the pan, stir to combine, and simmer on low heat

goals.description: Add mushroom stock to the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person opens the mushroom stock, pours it into the pan, and uses a teaspoon to scoop out the remaining stock.

goals.description: Add sour cream to the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person opens the sour cream pot and uses a spoon to scoop the cream into the frying pan until the pot is empty.

goals.description: Stir the ingredients together and adjust the heat
goals.rationale: The person cleans the utensils used for the stock and cream, stirs the mixture in the pan with a spatula, and adjusts the hob heat to bring it to a boil.
The person continues to stir the food to ensure even cooking and adjusts the heat again to maintain a low simmer.
